therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Number of participants experiencing adverse events (AEs) on study from Day 1 through end of post-study period (up to Day 25)

results.effect_size: LS Mean Difference in 24-hr WMG on Last Dosing Day: 37.63 mg/dL (95% CI 12.58-62.68) and 92.30 mg/dL (95% CI 67.56-117.04) vs placebo
biomarker_changes: 24-hour weighted mean glucose decreased dose-dependently on First Dosing Day (range -5.3 to -43.8 mg/dL across MK-1006 arms vs +5.3 mg/dL placebo)
24-hour weighted mean glucose decreased on Last Dosing Day in higher-dose arms (e.g. -66.9 mg/dL at 80 mg QD, -62.1 mg/dL at 50 mg BID vs +30.2 mg/dL placebo)
Lower doses (20 mg QD, 40 mg QD, 120 mg QD) showed attenuated or near-zero glucose lowering on Last Dosing Day suggesting possible tachyphylaxis at 120 mg QD
subgroup_findings: On First Dosing Day, dose-dependent glucose lowering observed across panels
On Last Dosing Day, 80 mg QD and 50 mg BID showed greatest glucose lowering; 120 mg QD showed diminished effect (-7.4 mg/dL) compared to First Dosing Day (-41.5 mg/dL)
safety_signals: No participants discontinued due to AEs in Panels A-G
1 participant each in Panel H (120 mg QD outpatient) and Panel I (50 mg BID outpatient) discontinued due to AE
1 serious AE of appendicitis in Panel H (120 mg QD outpatient)
1 serious AE of atrial fibrillation in placebo arm

dose_info.schedule: Once daily or twice daily for 10 days

context.duration: 10 days dosing plus post-study period up to Day 25
context.investigator_commentary: Trial was terminated; reason not stated in the record.
